title: Foresee to Trade: Forecast-Augmented Policy Optimization for Portfolio Management
abstract: arXiv:2611.07750v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online investment services must translate asset opportunities into investment outcomes for users' accounts, yet the same market opportunity can warrant different account actions. We study how supervision from future asset opportunities can strengthen account-level trading decisions and propose Forecast-Augmented Relative Policy Optimization (FRPO). FRPO separately supervises asset opportunities and account decisions through a jointly learned representation: a Financial State Head (FSH) learns future relative-return targets to provide asset-level opportunity supervision, while Same-Path Group-Relative Optimization compares trading trajectories under the same market path and initial account to provide account-level relative-outcome supervision. An Adaptive Gate coordinates auxiliary supervision using predictive variance and gradient alignment. FSH is used only during training; inference uses the encoder and policy for trading. Across DJIA3

translated_title: 预见以交易：面向投资组合管理的预测增强策略优化
translated_abstract: 在线投资服务必须将资产机会转化为用户账户的投资收益，然而相同的市场机会可能需要不同的账户操作。我们研究来自未来资产机会的监督如何能够强化账户级别的交易决策，并提出预测增强相对策略优化（FRPO）。FRPO 通过一个联合学习的表示分别监督资产机会和账户决策：金融状态头（FSH）学习未来相对收益目标，以提供资产级别的机会监督；同路径组相对优化则在相同市场路径和初始账户条件下比较交易轨迹，以提供账户级别的相对结果监督。自适应门控利用预测方差和梯度对齐来协调辅助监督。FSH 仅在训练阶段使用；推理阶段仅使用编码器和策略进行交易。在 DJIA……
tldr: 提出 FRPO 框架，通过金融状态头（FSH）对资产级机会进行未来收益监督，并结合同路径组相对优化对账户级交易轨迹进行相对结果监督，以强化投资组合管理中的账户级交易决策。
en_tdlr: Proposes FRPO, a forecast-augmented relative policy optimization framework that supervises asset opportunities via a Financial State Head and account decisions via same-path group-relative optimization, strengthening account-level trading for portfolio management.
